scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: uv run --project apps/backend uvicorn app.main:app --env-file .env --app-dir apps/backend --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.test: uv run --project apps/backend pytest apps/backend/tests && node --test apps/frontend/tests/*.test.js
